1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, wherein said aero cover is __integrally formed with said body panel__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, and __said aero cover extends across both said first and second forward corners__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, and __said aero cover is positioned to bridge between said first and second sections__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, wherein __said first and second aero covers are each integrally formed with said body panel__.

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, and __said first aero cover is integrally molded to cover said first section__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, and __said second aero cover is integrally molded to cover said second section__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, and __said aero covers are integrally formed during a single molding process with said body panel__.

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress, and __said first and second aero covers are integrally formed as part of said respective buttresses__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, and __said aero covers are integrally molded with said buttresses__.

11. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa, and __said aero covers are integrally formed from the same material as said body panel__.

12. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers, and __said aero covers are integrally molded from the same polypropylene reinforced material__.

13. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm, and __said aero covers are integrally formed with said body panel__.

14. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm, and __said aero covers are integrally molded as a single piece with said body panel__.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, wherein __said first and second aero covers are integrally formed with said body panel__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, and __said aero covers are integrally molded with said first and second sections__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, and __said aero covers are integrally formed with their respective buttresses__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, and __said first aero cover is integrally molded to enclose said first open rib structure__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, and __said second aero cover is integrally molded to enclose said second open rib structure__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, and __said aero covers are integrally formed during a single molding operation with said body panel__.
